name: Cypress Spring / Holmes Creek
coordinateNote: FDEP spring monitoring point. Water access required; not a drive-to entrance.

navigationNote: Directions use the public access point or operator venue. The map pin can mark the water feature; follow the access description.
experience: Paddle Holmes Creek into a vivid blue spring bowl for a swim and snorkel, with wooded banks and a substantial spring vent below. Cypress is the main destination of the outing. DEP places it near Cotton Landing; equipped guided trips are also advertised. Its Panhandle location makes it a separate regional trip, worth pairing with other northern springs rather than squeezing into a St Augustine day.
duration: Allow a half-day or longer for an outfitted excursion; exact trip length depends on pickup.

name: Lake Delancy West OHV Campground
coordinateNote: Entrance, parking or campsite coordinates from the November 12, 2026 research.
navigationDestination: Lake Delancy West Campground, Fort McCoy, FL
navigationNote: Drive to the listed entrance; follow the access description on arrival.
experience: Primitive pine-forest sites along the west shore of Lake Delancy, shared with off-road riders and Florida Trail hikers. Fire rings, picnic tables and vault toilets; no showers or drinking water. About 30 miles and 46 minutes from Juniper Springs.
access: Book and pay ahead. Stay limit: 14 consecutive days in a 30-day period Ocala WMA general gun season is Nov 14, 2026 - Jan 10, 2027 in the Pipeline, Hopkins Prairie and Lake Delancy units (Church Lake Unit on the far west edge: Nov 14-22 and Nov 28 - Dec 6). FWC 2026-27 brochure: 'During the general gun season, camping is prohibited, except in designated campgrounds and Juniper Prairie Wilderness.' Forest Service: 'Camping is allowed only in designated campsites during general gun season.' This is a designated campground, so it stays legal for the whole trip. Hunters will be on the surrounding forest roads; deer hunters must wear 500 sq in of fluorescent orange, and it is sensible to wear orange on trails outside the campground.
